title.narrative: Programa de Infraestructura Vial para la Competitividad Regional (Proregin 1)
Road Infrastructure Program for Regional Competitiveness (Proregion 1)

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es contribuir a mejorar la conectividad regional del pas, a travs de la rehabilitacin, mejoramiento y conservacin de vas de la red vial departamental, que resultarn en mejoras de acceso a corredores logsticos, la circulacin de personas e integracin regional, y la resiliencia de la infraestructura a los efectos del cambio climtico.

The objective of the program is to contribute to improving the regional connectivity of the country, through the rehabilitation, improvement and maintenance of the roads of the departmental road network, which will result in improvements in access to logistics corridors, the movement of people and regional integration, and infrastructure resilience to the effects of climate change.
